name: DBM
description: Issues the Budget Call, evaluates proposals, prepares the President's budget, releases allotments and cash authority, and owns most budget systems.

name: DOF

name: BTr

name: BSP

name: Servicing banks

name: BTMS
full_name: BTMS, Budget and Treasury Management System
description: Budget Execution Module with five functions: commitment and obligations, payments, receipts, property, accounting and financial reporting. See section 5 Status: DBM and BTr use it; five more pilot agencies prepare in 2026; plan of 110 agencies in 2027 and 198 in 2028 [INQ-BTMS]. A speech of January 2026 gives other dates and numbers [DBM-SPEECH26]. The SFA6 midterm plan reports a baseline of two onboarded agencies with 0.00030% of pilot-agency budget executed through BTMS [SFA6], which does not establish an October 2026 deployment count. The vendor states that DBM selected the FreeBalance Accountability Suite for BTMS in a cloud deployment [FB-PR2024], that it has worked with DBM since 2014, and that BTMS covers a Portal and the Budget Management, Budget Execution, Treasury and Cash Management, Accounting and Fiscal Reporting functions and is used by 430 national agencies [FB-CASE]. A first BTMS was launched in 2019 with a pilot at DBM and BTr [OGA-BTMS2019].
basis: CL2025-8, BTMS-SITE, INQ-BTMS, SFA6, DBM-SPEECH26, FB-PR2024, FB-CASE, OGA-BTMS2019
atlas_ref: Reference B, section 2: BTMS, Budget and Treasury Management System
note: Four accounts of the scale of BTMS disagree (Reference G point 2, plus the vendor page). See gap GAP-BTMS-SCALE.

name: PhilGEPS (modernized)
full_name: PhilGEPS, Philippine Government Electronic Procurement System, modernized version
description: By law the single electronic portal for procurement, from planning to payment. The rules list its features: bulletin board, electronic catalogue, virtual store, electronic marketplace, electronic bidding, electronic small value procurement, electronic reverse auction, electronic payment, registry of suppliers, open data. They require every procuring entity to use it fully, and they require an audit trail that COA may verify at any time. The Procurement Service names two facilities of the modernized version for common-use supplies and equipment: a Virtual Store, and an eMarketplace whose first items are motor vehicles, airline tickets, software licences and cloud computing services. The state in September 2025, from a resolution of the GPPB: an earlier version, PhilGEPS 1.5, and the modernized version existed at the same time. As of 31 August 2025, 69 agencies used at least four modules of the electronic bidding facility of the modernized version. The earlier version takes no new posting from 1 March 2026, and its complete decommissioning was planned for the first semester of 2026. Payment in the Electronic Marketplace: an eWallet that PhilGEPS issues, a Government Purchase Card, or another authorized electronic mode. Since October 2025 the registry of the beneficial owners of bidders is published through PhilGEPS, on an interim authority of the GPPB. Whether the dates were kept, and which features are in use in October 2026: not verified
basis: RA12009 s.20, IRR12009 s.20, s.22.1, PS-FAQ, ROADMAP2024, GPPB2025-09, GPPB2025-10, GPPB2025-11, PHILGEPS-ODP

name: Local government systems
description: Own budget, treasury and accounting tools. Local governments are not users of UACS
atlas_ref: Reference B, section 2: Local government systems

name: NGHRPS
full_name: NGHRPS, National Government HR and Payroll System
owner: Not stated in the part I could read
description: One system for personnel and payroll
atlas_ref: Reference B, section 3: NGHRPS, National Government HR and Payroll System

name: Unified portal
description: One place for fiscal documents. The COMPASS portal of section 2 is in use since June 2026. The sources that I read do not say that it is this planned portal
atlas_ref: Reference B, section 3: Unified portal and mobile applications

name: Hub for local governments
description: The Roadmap figure names eBudget, eCAT, ePFMAT, National Tax Allotment and the National Wealth Portal. The functions of eCAT and ePFMAT are not explained in the sources I read
atlas_ref: Reference B, section 3: Hub for local governments

name: Uniform payment system for procurement
full_name: Electronic and uniform payment system for procuring entities and suppliers
description: The procurement rules say that it "shall be defined in the context of the Integrated Financial Management Information System to be developed by the DBM, COA, and Department of Finance"
atlas_ref: Reference B, section 3: Electronic and uniform payment system for procuring entities and suppliers

name: Document management system
full_name: Document management system named for a BTMS interface (owner and name not stated)
description: The circular on BTMS foresees an interface with document management. It names neither the system nor its owner.

name: 1 Commitment and obligations
description: Purchase request, commitment, purchase order, obligation request. An obligation request is made manually, from a commitment, or from an approved purchase order. The system blocks commitments and obligations above the allotment.

name: 2 Payments
description: Goods received note, goods return note, disbursement voucher, payment by electronic funds transfer (PESONet, InstaPay) or check, payment extract, daily bank reconciliation from electronic bank statements. Payee details come from the supplier database.

name: 3 Receipts
description: Revenue voucher and revenue receipt voucher.

name: 4 Property, plant and equipment
description: Register of assets and asset transactions.

name: 5 Accounting and reporting
description: Journal entry voucher created by the system from vouchers, revenue vouchers and asset transactions; ledgers; reports FAR 1 to 6, BAR 1, registry of allotments, NCA listings. Entries at the end of a period are made manually.

name: Budget management (later)
description: A budget management module after the Budget Execution Module.

name: Treasury modules (later)
description: Treasury modules after the Budget Execution Module.

name: Cash flow forecasting (planned)
description: An integrated cash flow forecasting module or tool, fed by automated exchange with e-Budget and URS, to replace fragmented tools and manual processes for the monthly cash program. Design from 2026, development and rollout from 2027.

name: Off-budget accounts (planned)
description: Off-budget accounts to be recorded in BTMS, or in URS if that is not feasible. Feasibility report in the fourth quarter of 2026, pilot in 2028.

name: Electronic bulletin board
description: Posting of opportunities, notices and awards.

name: Electronic catalogue
description: A feature that the rules list.

name: Virtual Store
description: Facility for common-use supplies and equipment.

name: Electronic Marketplace
description: First items: motor vehicles, airline tickets, software licences and cloud services. Payment by an eWallet issued by PhilGEPS, a Government Purchase Card or another authorized electronic mode; the Procurement Service pays the merchant after the entity accepts the goods.

name: Electronic bidding
description: As of 31 August 2025, 69 agencies used at least four modules of the electronic bidding facility of the modernized version.

name: Electronic small value procurement
description: A feature that the rules list.

name: Electronic reverse auction
description: A feature that the rules list.

name: Electronic payment
description: The rules require a payment feature that can interface with the bank of the procuring entity. Its status is not stated.

name: Registry of suppliers
description: Registration of suppliers, contractors and consultants.

name: Open Data Portal
description: Open data on notices, awards, agencies, merchants and observers in downloadable formats, launched on 21 October 2025.

name: Beneficial ownership registry
description: Since October 2025 the registry of the beneficial owners of bidders is published through PhilGEPS, on an interim authority of the GPPB.

name: Budget execution documents
description: BED 1 financial plan, BED 2 physical plan, BED 3 monthly disbursement program.

name: Accountability reports
description: BAR 1 and FAR 1 to 6. Only reports generated by URS are accepted.

name: Tier 1 forms
description: Forms for the cost of ongoing programs (forward estimates).

name: Tier 2 forms
description: Forms for new or expanded programs, with tags such as climate change expenditure.

name: PSIPOP
description: List of positions and personnel: authorized positions, filled and vacant, updated each month.

name: Advice of checks
description: Advice of checks issued and cancelled.

name: Payment of accounts payable
description: Payment of accounts payable to creditors (the LDDAP-ADA).

name: Transfer of allocations
description: Transfer of fund allocations.

name: Checkbook request
description: Request for checkbooks.
